answers.core: I've attempted to make mockups of a UDim2 and UDim2 anchor (as seen above for the code snippets) but as it stands right now it's not as effective as having it built into the engine as tool scripts don't exactly mesh well with anchors and positioning. On top of that I don't think that shortcomings of the current system should be offset to addons, some features should be official.
answers.workaround:
It could possibly be a project setting so possibly games that still use pixel measurements can stay the same without having to change their units much. Beyond that if you wish to use pixels still you can use the Offset in the UDim2 unit.

there could also be conversion methods so Vector2 could still be used like `from_offset(x: int, y: int)`
